summary.text: Jeff Yarbro is a Democratic state senator from Nashville who represents Tennessee Senate District 21 in part of Davidson County and is listed as the incumbent candidate in the 2026 election.
An attorney, he is the Senate Democratic Leader.

paragraphs.text: Jeff Yarbro was born on February 16, 1977, and is married with two children, according to the Tennessee General Assembly.
He earned a B.A. from Harvard University and a J.D. from the University of Virginia and is an attorney.
Yarbro has been a member of the Senate from the 109th through the 114th General Assemblies.
He serves on the Senate Finance, Ways and Means, Health and Welfare, State and Local Government, and Rules committees, among others.
He is a member of the Nashville Bar Association and the Tennessee Bar Association.
